notes.title: V1.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This is a regular update.

Update Details:

 Added difficulty levels 26-30
 Added new achievements
 Adjusted the positions of some buttons in the quick menu interface to prevent misclicks


Note:Players using different versions cannot form teams or see room lists.

This project took us a year of full-time development, consuming a great deal of our time and financial resources. Unfortunately, sales have been dismal, and our two-person studio can no longer sustain itself. We have no choice but to seek jobs to cover our living expenses. As a result, future updates for the game will take longer to release. Life is tough, and we hope for your understanding QAQ.
We are deeply grateful for your support! The new year is approaching, and we wish you happiness and good health!

notes.title: V1.3 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
This update focuses on game balance adjustments.

Update Details:

 Difficulty levels 21–25 are now available.
 Reduced the damage of the Saint's "Binding Totem" and "Healing Totem."
 Increased the values for Berserker's "Battle Hunger" and reduced the internal cooldown of "Counter Spiral" by 50%.
 Enhanced the damage of Vampire's "Blood Burst" against enemies.
 Lowered the attack power of ranged bosses but increased their attack range.
 Decreased the damage of the "Glass Cannon" plugin.
 Improved the attributes of the following plugins: "Athlete," "Death Rattle," "Emergency Escape," "Gold Amulet," "XP Amulet," "Reinforcement," "Fat Sheep's Friend," "Hardened Skin," "Integrity," "Impairment," "Cold Heart," "Heavyweight Player," "Mana Burst," "Mana Overflow," "Recovery," "Survivor," "Vampire," and "Symbiote."
 Increased the maximum damage reduction rate for melee classes to 99%.



Note: Different versions cannot form teams, nor can they see the room list.

notes.title: Version 1.2 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Thank you so much for your feedback! If you encounter any issues or are dissatisfied with any aspect of the gameplay, please let us know in the community. We review your feedback daily.

Update Details:

 Respawn timer in single-player mode is now 1 second.
 The game will pause when opening the shop or pressing ESC in single-player mode.
 Significantly reduced the difficulty of Level 1: monster attributes are decreased by 60%, and players earn 100% more gold and experience.
 Greatly increased the attack range of melee classes.
 Enhanced the thief’s initial movement and attack speed, while reducing the mana cost of the gunslinger’s skills.
 All classes now have a basic MP regeneration rate.
 Added new explanations in the in-game help section.
 Significantly reduced the attack power of invading monsters and ghosts.
 Increased the armor value provided by equipment.
 Elite monsters can now drop equipment.
 Item slots in the inventory now have different border colors based on item quality for easier distinction.
 Increased gold drops from monsters.



Note: Players using different versions cannot form teams or see each other’s room lists.


If you think our game is enjoyable, please give us a recommendation. We would greatly appreciate your support!
